acceptance: Red first: the run record of a report without the required heading names that heading, and the deliverable file is kept beside the record.
The seat prompt carries the required headings that phase.json declares (a test over the composed prompt).
Docs: the runner package note changes in STE; 100% coverage on each changed function; zero code comments.
fix: Make the section contract hold by construction: the runner composes the deliverable skeleton (the required headings) into the seat prompt from phase.json require_sections, and the verification failure names each missing heading in the run record and keeps the failing deliverable next to the record. Red test: a seat report with '## Result' and no '## Simplifications' records the missing heading and keeps the file.
summary: 2026-11-13, worktree dev/cl-f3 (F3 idle grace): four code-simplifier runs in a row (agent-code-simplifier-20261113T182343Z-bb70, T183054Z-96f4, T183742Z-dcc1, T184754Z-09f6, T185428Z-e722) found nothing to change, but the runner downgraded each to FAIL with RUNNER_DELIVERABLE_UNVERIFIED codes=missing_section. .evolve/phases/code-simplifier/phase.json require_sections is ["Simplifications"]; the model wrote headings such as '## Result', '## Checked', '## Notes', and in one run ignored a brief that named the exact headings. The commit gate needs a simplifier PASS bound to the staged tree, so a clean change cannot ship. The run record (.evolve/agent-runs/*.json) does not say which section was missing, and without --keep the deliverable is deleted, so the failure cannot be inspected.
title: The code-simplifier seat records FAIL (missing_section) when its report says no change is needed
